preview.title:
AI / Tech on Instagram: "China is flooding AI with free tools.

Some of the country’s biggest tech companies are making increasingly capable AI products available with free access or generous free tiers. The list now includes names like Qwen, DeepSeek, Kimi, Doubao, ERNIE, Dreamina and several fast-growing models that are still barely known outside China.

These tools cover everything from coding and research to image generation and AI agents. Some also offer huge context windows or multimodal features that would normally sit behind paid plans elsewhere.

The AI race is becoming a fight over access, not only who has the smartest model.

Which of these would you try first?"
